subject: Ten-Year Solid Waste Agreement Authorization
overview: The City Council authorized the mayor to enter into a 10-year solid waste and composting agreement and approved a new council rule allowing outside consultant fees to be charged to special permit applicants. The council also approved common victualler licenses and debated recent road safety interventions at Winthrop Street and Playstead Road.

items.title: Disability Pride Month Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution officially recognizing and celebrating July as Disability Pride Month in Medford.

items.title: Common Victualler Licenses
items.summary: Approved common victualler licenses for Matsuba Izakaya Sushi Bar and Grill at 38 Riverside Avenue, Four Seasons Boba Tea at 34 Riverside Avenue, and Ho-Win Palace 2 at 269 Middlesex Avenue.

items.title: Spring Street Truck Restriction Request
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution asking the Traffic Commission to consider truck weight or travel restrictions on Spring Street and requesting enforcement by the Traffic Division if adopted.

items.title: Ten-Year Solid Waste Agreement Authorization
items.summary: Authorized the mayor to enter into a 10-year agreement for citywide collection, disposal, and processing of solid waste, reusables, organics, and recyclables.

items.title: Winthrop Street and Playstead Road Interventions
items.summary: Placed on file a resolution discussing recent roadway and intersection alterations at Winthrop Street and Playstead Road following extensive debate over traffic safety versus aesthetic concerns regarding temporary plastic barriers.

items.title: Council Rule 39 on Consultant Fees
items.summary: Approved an amendment to the City Council rules adopting Rule 39 under state law to allow the council to hire outside professional consultants at the petitioner's expense when acting as a special permit granting authority.

items.title: DPW Equipment Purchases via ARPA
items.summary: Received and placed on file a presentation by the DPW commissioner regarding proposed ARPA allocations exceeding $250,000 for a jet truck and a loader to replace aging equipment.

items.title: Cooling Centers Announcement
items.summary: Councilor Tseng announced locations and operating hours for city cooling centers open ahead of a forecasted heat wave.
